_: Every threshold the loop enforces, in one place (ml-feedback-loop design, 'Guards on every auto-commit'). Code reads these; it does not carry its own defaults, so a number here is the number that fired.
_cluster: Attempts chain into a same-scene cluster at gaps no larger than this, and the chain SPLITS when the dominant class changes or adjacent argmax class sets are disjoint. Transitive chaining alone would merge dish A and dish B captured 90 s apart and feed the false inconsistency to the regression flag.
_floor: Req 4.3. The device-vs-replay delta below which no gap component may be attributed to a data cause, taken over SKEW-FREE pairs only: once the loop lands fixes, HEAD-vs-device drift would otherwise absorb the loop's own effect and report it as replay noise. Below min_pairs the floor is unmeasured and every fix demotes to a proposal.
_evidence: Req 5.3. An auto-applied value change needs this many distinct captures, spread over this many clusters, all agreeing in direction.
_drift: Symmetric, both directions. The per-cycle ceiling is a rate limiter, not a bound (1.15^10 is about 4x), so the lifetime ceiling is anchored to the ORIGINAL CoFID/AFCD source value and is what actually bounds drift.
_dof: One degree of freedom per class per cycle, plus a cooldown on the column that moved: fix_id-keyed denylisting cannot see cross-column oscillation on the same class.
_eval_floor: Derivation refuses to consume captures when doing so would drop any (class, capture mode) evaluation cell below this, so the metric cannot quietly go `insufficient` through its own training appetite.
_min_cell: Report cells below this carry `insufficient` rather than a figure, following tools/shortlist_hit_rate.py.
_mixing: Req 8.5. Field captures may be at most this share of merged train images, so one developer's kitchen, plates, and lighting cannot dominate the corpus.
_commit: Req 5.7: every auto-commit is marked as machine authorship. The address is deliberately unroutable — nobody is meant to reply to the loop.
_calibration: Decision 20: `make food-db` aborts rather than re-bake a database that carries calibration lineage without the artifact that produced it. With this null the build gate fails and every fix demotes to a proposal — the safe direction.
_denylist: Fix ids a prior verdict flagged as regressive (Req 5.7). The loop never re-applies one.
